customer_outcome: One continuous display-backing wall, with the fixed pump lead unloaded during customer cartridge removal.

mechanical_basis.cartridge_separation_load_path: Contact body and ears to the two M1.4 screws in the fixed bulkhead; the fixed ribbon does not move with the cartridge.
mechanical_basis.lead_tension: Support the free harness while assembling or repairing the appliance. Leave the insulated solder-joint exit relaxed and disconnect J13 by its housing before separating enclosure pieces.

evidence_limits: No complete installed wire route, physical harness fit, vibration, wire pull-load or lifetime result is claimed. Accepted connector test-piece fit and mating results retain their original scope.
scope: Local native wall geometry and the fixed contact load path. Installed harness routing is not qualified by this record.

routing_review.stock: 350 mm 22 AWG 4P silicone ribbon; nominal 6.8 by 1.7 mm section; individual heat-shrink on the four solder joints.
routing_review.intended_local_route: Bulkhead lead bore and crown below the frame, returning through the +X interior cavity clear of the manifold Wago and tube approaches.
routing_review.known_constraints: A straight run at X93.5, Z292.2 from Y104.5 to Y204.5 crosses the manifold Wago and front-top stock. A crosswise run at Y104.5, Z292.2 crosses fluid-14 and fluid-16. The exact route, ribbon attitude and termination access require an installed harness model.
routing_review.normal_service_motion: The contact pair parts while both fixed lead endpoints remain mounted. Support the free lead during assembly and repair, and unplug J13 by its housing before separating enclosure pieces.
